description: This file defines a React functional component 'MindmapFiltersBar' that displays a filter UI for a mindmap feature, including sliders for salary range and skill similarity, and a dropdown for time horizon. It handles user interactions to update filter values.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Updates the salary range filter values based on slider input.

methods.name: setSimilarity
methods.description: Sets the minimum skill similarity filter, constrained between 0 and 1.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all filters to their default states.
